QuestInfo.name: Mysterious Wanderer
QuestInfo.0: A mysterious man rushed past you. When you turned to look, you noticed he dropped something shiny. What is it?
QuestInfo.1: The mysterious man dropped a Pocket Watch. You don't see anything special about it, but it doesn't seem to work, and the name #b#p2082004##k was engraved inside. Hey, what does that button on the top do?
QuestInfo.2: When you pressed the button, you were instantly transported to a forest you've never seen. The mysterious man was there, staring at you in shock. His name is #b#p2082004##k, but who is he? And for that matter, what is this watch?
QuestInfo.demandSummary: #bTalk to Syras, the ticket agent at Ariant Station.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 99,190\nAndy the Time Traveler is now available.\n

0.0: Long time no see. I know what brings you here. People come to me for one thing: #einformation#n. Unfortunately, my memory's gotten a bit fuzzy, so I got nothing. Though #b5000 mesos#k might clear it up.

1.0: You... Did you just activate the watch?!\r\n#L0##bSo...this is your watch? Who are you? And what just happened?#l\n#k
1.1: My name is Andy, and this is the Tera Forest Time Gate. Now, you tell me. Did you really activate the watch? \r\n#L0##bYes, I think so. I just pressed the button on the top. What's this all about?#l\n#k
1.2: It can't be... I thought the watch was out of power... Here, let me see the watch.

yes.0: Look, we don't have time for this. Let me know when you change your mind.
